title: Repository Review
scope: Line-by-line review of wingbangboozle1-lang/NBA1 at commit 2f44c98 (main, after PR #18), plus every file this session added.
method: Every claim below was checked by opening the file or running the command named in the 'check' column. Nothing is accepted because a page says so. Where the check needed an official source, the official URL is given.
verdict: No incorrect number, broken link or fabricated source was found in the merged tree. The irregularities found are structural and are listed at the end: two labs with no shared navigation, stale dated counts in older authored pages, a refresh script that has never run, and eight pages whose data is a snapshot rather than a live feed.

tree.note: Loads only local styles.css and app.js. All internal links resolve. Its 31-game Nov 13-16 figures are labelled with the capture they belong to but are now dated.

continue-on-error guards every step; a failure leaves the previous snapshot live. See R01.

irregularities.issue: Two labs, one repository, no shared navigation
irregularities.impact: A reviewer lands on the root dashboard and cannot see the second build.
irregularities.action_taken: Added a shared navigation shell and a single Command Center entry point; did not modify the other session's pages.

irregularities.issue: Older authored pages quote a 31-game Nov 13-16 window and a 12:00 PM ET injury snapshot
irregularities.impact: Stale but not false: they describe the capture they belong to.
irregularities.action_taken: Left in place (owned by another session) and superseded by the dated Command Center.

irregularities.issue: The refresh pipeline has never run end to end (fetch_official.py -> pipeline.py -> build_site.py)
irregularities.impact: Not a data error: a GitHub-hosted probe on 2026-11-14T00:58Z reached all seven principal official sources with HTTP 200, so the network path works. What is unproven is the parsers, and no 11/14 injury PDF exists to fetch yet.
irregularities.action_taken: Recorded the probe as evidence, narrowed the claim to the parsers, and tried to dispatch the workflow — GitHub returned 403 for this token, which is recorded rather than worked around.

irregularities.issue: No market price anywhere; the 'reference line' is internal
irregularities.impact: Economic gates are measured against a construction, not a book.
irregularities.action_taken: Labelled on every page that shows an edge.

irregularities.impact: Availability impact is a lower bound.
irregularities.action_taken: Published a coverage figure beside every impact number.

irregularities.issue: Four of ten strategies generated zero plays
irregularities.impact: Their leaderboard rows are 0.0 and look like failures of measurement rather than of edge.
irregularities.action_taken: Marked 'not funded - research only' with the reason.

irregularities.issue: Signed error columns were rendered as if absolute in the game log
irregularities.impact: A reader could read a 40-point miss as a 40-point hit. No published metric changes, because the averages were already means of absolute values.
irregularities.action_taken: Relabelled the columns with the sign convention, switched the row filter to compare magnitudes, and flagged it as R13.
